regime_conditional_ranker._comment: RANK-REBUILD-2026-06-13 (audit docs/signal_screener_audit_2026_06_13). When _enabled, decision_engine ranks/promotes on rank_score while keeping score>=`gate_floor` as a quality GATE; the composite score is demoted from ranker to gate. DEFAULT OFF: rank_score is always computed + emitted (for A/B observation) but does not drive the verdict until flipped. Reversible: set _enabled=false. Weights live in signal_rank.DEFAULT_WEIGHTS unless overridden in `weights` below.

The 60-69 composite band loses in BOTH logs, FULL history AND post-ranker (>=06-13): picks_history 60-69 PF 0.79 full / 65-69 PF 0.20 post; signal_log 60-69 PF 0.55 full / 65-69 PF 0.44 post. The 70-89 band is the edge (picks 1.35 / signal 1.70 full). Asymmetric-safe: a GATE raise only REMOVES ~562 confirmed-losing trades (combined -474% totR), cannot add trades. Reversible: set gate_floor=60 (backup config/config.json.bak.20260706_113721). Walk-forward (wf_accuracy_20260706, running) corroborates OOS and may justify pushing to 75/80.

Thresholds calibrated on the RIGHT population = actual historical BUY-verdict trades w/ resolved outcomes (NOT gate-passers, NOT full universe — those have selection bias: picks_history is curated/taken trades scoring higher than the live all_scored universe). Calibration: CHOPPY rank>=36 keeps ~65% of historical BUYs lifting PF 0.95->1.25 (rank>=40 => PF 1.54 / 47% keep); TRENDING BUYs barely separate by rank (all PF ~1.24-1.27, n=135) so threshold set near pool median 50 to trim the bottom half pending more trending-regime data.
